title: Broadloom 37x27 — first whole-map Arc Relay candidate
note: UNIMPLEMENTED DESIGN CANDIDATE, west-team perspective — not the live map. Requires an explicit platform change: ArenaMap.MaxWidth 32 -> at least 37 (999 total tiles, below the 1,024-cell budget). Scoring is the exact reactor tile inside each protected pad. Workshops are proposed neutral veterancy sites; no workshop rules exist yet.

routes.label: Return when the home door is cut
Deep raid on the enemy heal

combatReference.source: ArcRelayLoopProfile.Current (Tapline15) base profiles: vision 5 facing-quadrant with zero omnidirectional proximity, guns 3/4/6, Rail 12 separate. Signatures and veterancy excluded.

tacticalSites.label: N workshop
tacticalSites.note: Three wide mouths plus a sealable skylight and roof overwatch; one Mason can never seal it, two leave a +6 bounded detour.

tacticalSites.label: Centre plaza
tacticalSites.note: Staggered cover around the 2-Well caps its longest rail line at 5 and keeps all eight Well exits open: no two-tile seal can entomb it. Pincer approaches stay separate until y10.

tacticalSites.label: Enemy Well room
tacticalSites.note: West's 4-value raid target: four doors on three families plus two 1-wide shadow seams; the defender cannot watch all of them from one facing.

tacticalSites.label: Own Well room
tacticalSites.note: Mirror of the enemy room: the home door faces the pad lane, the east door faces the enemy raid theatre.

tacticalSites.label: Own heal room
tacticalSites.note: Home-quarter recovery with three doors; one Null Field blankets the whole room, so heal denial is a real play.

tacticalSites.label: North flank and galleries
tacticalSites.note: The committed flank: roof gallery, NE field and the pad-exit avenue; patrol posts, a mine pinch and the deep-raid crossing.

tacticalSites.label: Home pads
tacticalSites.note: Spawn-protected pads with the exact scoring reactor inside; no pad tile can rail or even see any Well, heal or workshop.
